sentences.text: Respondent Order Sheet 04/12/2024 Mr. Akash Kumar Kundu, Advocate for the Petitioner.
Heard.
Issue notice to Respondent on payment of process fee, as per rules.
Notice be made returnable within 03 weeks.
Also heard on I.A. No. 01/2024 which is an application for grant of interim relief.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that one criminal case is pending against the Respondent/Non-applicant in the Court at Raipur in Crime No. 114/2023 for alleged commission of offence under Section 498A, 506/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
The petitioner has also submitted an application under Section 125 of the Cr.P.C. for grant of maintenance which is pending before the Family Court Raipur.
In the said proceedings, the respondent has already caused his appearance.

The application under Section 13 (1) (1-a) and 13 (1) (1b) of the Hindu Marriage Act,
1955 is filed only 28.09.2024, during pendency of the other proceedings/cases at Raipur.

Therefore,
the civil suit seeking relief of decree of divorce be transferred to the Family Court at Raipur.

The case is fixed at Family Court, Kanker for appearance of the petitioner and if she would not appear,
she may be proceeded ex parte and therefore, the proceedings pending before the Family Court,
Kanker be stayed.
I have heard learned counsel for the petitioner.

Taking into consideration the facts and circumstances of the case, nature of grievance raised,
submission of the learned counsel for the petitioner as also, the documents placed on record, purely as an interim measure, it is directed that the further proceedings pending in Case No. 42-A/2024 Smt. Kajal Sharma vs Prashant Sharma on 4 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/6807253/
1
between the parties "Prashant Sharma Vs. Kajal Sharma" pending at Family Court, Kanker shall remain stayed till the next date of hearing.
List this case in the week commencing 13.01.2025.
